scope: team-agreed exploratory cohort; strict protocol assessment in parallel
selection_hierarchy: Require an explicitly designated index model or a single model; do not rank by observed AUROC
Prefer independent external validation, then patient-disjoint held-out internal test, then patient-disjoint cross-validation; flag apparent/unreported validation
Keep horizons separate; extraction supplies the 1-hour values for Yu 2022/2023, but these peak values are not a prespecified cross-study horizon
One estimate per conservative dependency group; unresolved overlap or representative-model choice blocks automatic pooling

exclusions.yu_2026: Composite adverse event performance, not cardiac arrest alone
exclusions.yu_2023_gnb: Graphical results without adequately extractable numerical estimates

auroc_method: Guarded logit AUROC REML, modified Hartung-Knapp t interval; no fit without genuine variances and independent comparable selected estimates
diagnostic_method: Guarded R mada::reitsma bivariate random-effects model; binomial HSROC preferred if eligible data later warrant it
minimum_counts_note: Conservative analyst feasibility safeguards for this project, not universal sample-size cutoffs; passing does not establish comparability or identifiability
public_evidence_policy: Aggregate extraction facts only; no supplied raw files, correspondence contents, personal contact details or unpublished free-text notes

model_exclusions.lu_2025_xgboost: Research-team decision: model excluded because sensitivity and specificity were extracted graphically and considered insufficiently reliable.
